horoscope: Mercury has been transiting your partnership sector in recent weeks, dear Aries, and it will move on tomorrow. It's put you in generally good shape in negotiations. Your curiosity about others and desire to communicate in your relationships have been notable. However, Mercury is opposite Chiron today, and something communicated can play on your vulnerabilities. This can lead to a breakthrough in understanding if you're open to learning about what emerges now. Even so, it can be tricky or messy. There may be a misunderstanding or something that needs clarification. You could feel criticized, even if others are not meaning to be pushy with you. You may want to take a step back from any emerging conflict that might occur now just so that you can react more mindfully. Fortunately, relationships seem to support your growth, and this feels right. You might gain clarity through a conversation or a chance meeting with a friend. You may very well stumble upon some information that supports the development of a friendship or a feeling of belonging.

There is a tendency for you to feel unappreciated or slighted in spots today, dear Taurus. Things may feel in limbo or undecided, which can undermine some of your endeavors if you don't nip it in the bud. The day may bring an uncomfortable revelation or heightened emotions, particularly around work or your workload. You have a hard time hearing what appears to be criticism now. Aim to deal with troubles as fearlessly as possible, but also with self-honesty for best results. Fortunately, today can bring you the right information at the right time, particularly related to work or health matters. A Mercury-North Node influence today helps connect you with people or information that supports your career or health goals, and your inclination to include others and network helps you more than meets the eye. This can be a time for gaining increased clarity about a life-path goal, project, or job that feels like growth and improvement.

You can be especially sensitive to imbalances in your social or love life today, dear Gemini. Something you hear or read may touch a nerve or trigger your insecurities. It's important to wait before coming to conclusions--reserve judgment, if possible. It's also a good idea to examine what seems to be touching on vulnerable spots, as you stand to learn a lot about yourself through interactions with others and their reactions. While conversations can be tricky, and possibly even messy, they might also be long overdue and lead to greater understanding. Fortunately, today stirs up good, creative ideas, so take note of some of the information coming your way. Someone may seek out your guidance, and you feel great about helping.

Communications and thoughts or memories can open up old emotional issues and challenge you today, dear Cancer, with Mercury opposite Chiron. Particularly if you've recently brushed aside deeper feelings, a comment could catch you off guard. For now, it's not intuitive to interact in ways that help relationships grow, as people can get defensive if they feel judged. Even so, you're also in a strong position to learn from these matters, as they can point you toward what most needs repair and healing. As well, connections to people who help you feel comfortable or who have a reassuring effect on you may be made. Family or the desire to improve home life can be at the heart of your goals. Links can be with people or information that point you in the right direction.

With Mercury opposite Chiron today, dear Leo, there can be some touchiness. What you or a friend is interpreting from your communications can be heavily influenced by insecurities. You might receive a wake-up call about a project or idea that needs some more refinement before going forward, and this can certainly be helpful. It can be frustrating if others challenge your views or opinions. Even so, you might discover that you can learn something valuable from your differences. Also, ideas are exciting, and you may make a useful connection now that helps you put them into action. You may learn something exciting or valuable about a friendship or cherished project.

It may be a little difficult to count on others in spots today, dear Virgo. The day can hold some minor disappointing energy in the relationship department. You may be a bit sensitive, especially if your ideas are challenged, since it can feel like criticism. Money worries or complicated power dynamics in a relationship can be a soft spot, and feelings may erupt and come out poorly. However, whatever emerges now can lead to growth and better understanding. Even if a comment irritates, it may very well jumpstart some creative thinking, leading to new insights. Nevertheless, you may want to hold off on drawing definite conclusions until you're more objective and less personally involved. Fortunately, the day holds promise for information that will help you further your work goals. You might make financial connections or find good advice.

A disconnect with someone or a feeling that you're not especially appreciated can occur now, dear Libra. Keep in mind that wishful thinking can distort your sense of value. The tendency to speak from the head instead of the heart, or to say things too matter-of-factly, can create challenges. Mercury is intelligent and intellectual, and it's currently transiting your sign. As it opposes Chiron today, something you say can be misunderstood or taken the wrong way. You might appear critical or judgmental when you're merely playing with ideas. Or, if you feel overwhelmed or burdened, you could too quickly jump to the wrong conclusions. Aim to learn from any differences or hurt feelings that might occur today. Even if you're entirely right, others' reactions can offer you a new way to see a matter. Fortunately, the day holds much promise when it comes to making connections with others, particularly creative ones. There can be a sense of renewal regarding your feelings about a matter or a better understanding of your dreams.

There may be a change of plans or confusing situations on a social level at times today, dear Scorpio. It may be best to be a little more attentive and vigilant with your work or routines since small worries or fears could interfere with clear thinking today. If a misunderstanding occurs, try to resolve it quickly and honestly, rather than offering lengthy explanations. With Mercury opposite Chiron today, words and actions may be triggering, despite even our best efforts. You're more comfortable observing and absorbing the happenings around you than contributing right now, which helps. You're in good shape for contemplation and behind-the-scenes study or work. If buried resentments surface, consider it to be revealing so that you can work through the problems. With the Moon in your opposite sign all day, you're inclined to seek out balance in your life. This likely involves giving special attention to the needs or agendas of important people in your life. As well, a Mercury-Node connection can inspire you and stimulate some great ideas for making living arrangements or family life more supportive and pleasant. Family projects or discussions can have significance now.

There can be some confusion or a bit of chaos in your schedule in spots today, dear Sagittarius. Words can hurt feelings easily, so choosing them a little more carefully might save you a few problems. With Mercury opposite Chiron, you may feel disconnected between your emotions and your intellect. Whether we overdo logic while ignoring emotional sensibilities, or the opposite, misunderstandings can arise. If this can't be avoided, it can turn into an opportunity to better understand yourself and others. Fortunately, today holds promise of potentially very useful information through friends, so keep yourself connected, but on your own terms.

With today's Mercury-Chiron opposition, it's all too easy for people to have defensive reactions to communications, dear Capricorn. The best approach is to aim to understand why certain things make you feel uncomfortable and learn from differences. With this transit, misunderstandings are often about words triggering problem areas. It makes the most sense to get to the bottom of the matter rather than address only the symptoms. Fortunately, a Mercury-Node connection also active today suggests you might make some meaningful connections. You have a strong desire to know that your future is relatively secure and that achieving your goals will satisfy you in the long run. Information can be in the offing that supports your finances or current business interests.

You are especially attracted to meaningful, unusual, or different topics with Mercury in your solar ninth house, dear Aquarius. While it's mostly a breezy transit, communication energies are a bit tricky today. There is some need for careful handling as Mercury opposes Chiron, and we can be more sensitive. A communication could challenge you, or it may seem unnecessarily critical. If you require more time to connect confidently with an opinion or idea, then take it. Differences are likely to be glaring just for now, but they can offer learning experiences. It's an excellent time to see flaws and differences more clearly, opening up a chance to repair problem areas. You are especially protective of people you care about today and might show your affection through your guidance or instruction.

With Mercury currently transiting your solar eighth house, just until tomorrow, dear Pisces, it's been a generally good time to bring more common sense to finances or relationships. You tend to look more deeply into a matter before taking off with it. You are in observer mode. However, with Mercury opposite Chiron today, there can be some tendency to misunderstand one another. You may feel you're walking on eggshells with people, and it's easier to recognize the flaws in a situation than to see what's working. The best way to manage this energy is to avoid picking sides or thinking in black-or-white terms. Considering individual truths is your best bet. If you're tempted to use this time to get a matter off your chest, be aware that words can come out messily, or people take things the wrong way. Fortunately, Mercury also forms some pleasant aspects, helping you make a nice connection with someone through your understanding manner. It can be a beautiful time for self-honesty and healing. Your cooperative, helpful nature comes shining through, making it natural for others to acknowledge your efforts.
